title: P01
extract_protocol_ch1: RNA was extracted using the RNeasy FFPE Kit (QIAGEN) according to the manufacturer’s protocol. Total RNA integrity was checked using the Bioptic Qsep100 (BIOptic) and quantified using a Synergy H1 (BioTek).
extract_protocol_ch1_2: RNA libraries were prepared for sequencing using standard Illumina protocols
data_processing: Read quality was checked for each sample using FastQC v0.11.3.
data_processing_2: Sequenced reads were trimmed for adaptor sequence, and masked for low-complexity or low-quality sequence, then mapped to human whole genome using START (2.5.3a) with parameters ""--quantMode TranscriptomeSAM --outFilterType BySJout --outSAMstrandField intronMotif --outSAMtype BAM Unsorted --outFilterMultimapNmax 20 --outFilterMismatchNmax 10 --outFilterMismatchNoverReadLmax 0.04 --alignSJoverhangMin 8 --alignSJDBoverhangMin 5 --alignIntronMin 20 --alignIntronMax 1000000 --alignMatesGapMax 1000000 --sjdbScore 2 --outFilterMatchNminOverLread 0.33 --outFilterScoreMinOverLread 0.33 --twopassMode Basic --chimSegmentMin 20 --chimJunctionOverhangMin 20 --chimSegmentReadGapMax 3 --alignSJstitchMismatchNmax 5 -1 5 5
data_processing_3: Aligned RNA reads were then analyzed by using RSEM (v1.3.0) to calculate gene expression levels.
data_processing_5: Supplementary_files_format_and_content: tab-delimited text files include genes and corresponding reads raw counts for sample.
data_processing_6: Supplementary_files_format_and_content: tab-delimited text files include genes and corresponding TPM values for sample.
